notes:
ACCESS: Tier (a) direct HTTP worked throughout - curl_cffi with impersonate='chrome120' bypassed the reCAPTCHA wall that blocked plain requests/curl (robots.txt itself returned a Flipkart reCAPTCHA HTML page under a bare curl UA, but succeeded at 200 under Chrome TLS impersonation). No Playwright/Chrome escalation was needed. robots.txt (fetched via curl_cffi) does not name anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot/Claude-Web with a full Disallow, so no tier restriction applied; tier (a) sufficed for the whole task. TREE METHOD: Flipkart is a general marketplace, so per the assignment scope only the Home & Kitchen home-furnishing/home-improvement vertical was enumerated, not the full catalog (electronics, apparel, mobiles, etc. excluded as general merchandise). Built the tree from the homepage footer + each category page's own left-sidebar CATEGORIES tree (store ids / sid= chain), which Flipkart renders server-side in the initial HTML. Textile tree root: Home Furnishing (sid=jra) with 8 sub-groups: Bed Linen & Blankets, Curtains & Accessories, Bath Linen, Floor Coverings, Cushions & Pillows, Covers & Protectors, Kitchen & Table Linen, Sofa & Curtain Fabrics - each expanded to its own leaf categories via each sub-group's own category page. Storage tree found under Home Improvement (sid=h1m) > Home Utilities and Organizers (sid=iee), specifically its Home Storage and Organization, Laundry, and Trolleys and Stands branches; no dedicated top-level 'Storage' vertical exists on Flipkart. QTY METHOD: every recorded qty is the exact number parsed from the leaf category page's own rendered header, pattern

NAME

(Showing 1-40 products of N products) - this is Flipkart's real listing total (verified not capped: several unrelated leaves independently exceed 10,000, e.g. Bolsters 10,164 and Table Covers 10,175, ruling out a display-cap artifact). h1 text was checked against the requested node on every leaf. EXCLUDED and why: Curtain Accessories (sid=jra,sl5,bqw) - sampled product titles are 100% metal curtain rods/hooks/knobs/brackets, i.e. hardware, excluded per textile.md Sec.5. Blinds (sid=jra,sl5,hkg) - sampled titles are predominantly PVC/plastic roller blinds, not clearly fabric, excluded per textile.md Sec.5's 'when clearly textile/fabric' qualifier. Table Cloth Clips, Napkin Rings (hardware/decor rings and clips) excluded per Sec.5/Sec.7 hardware boundary. Coasters excluded - mixed material (wood/ceramic/cork), not a listed textile product. Chef Hats excluded as apparel/headwear per Sec.19. On the Storage side: Microwave Wall Mounts, Step Ladders, Mail Boxes, Suggestion Boxes (home-storage-and-organization siblings), Cloth Dryer Stands, Hangers, Ironing Boards, Clothesline, Cloth Clips, Lint Rollers, Ironing Mats, Washing Machine Hoses (laundry siblings), and Appliance/Inverter/Luggage Trolleys (trolleys-and-stands siblings) were all excluded - none are genuine storage/organization products per storage.md's primary-function test (tools, drying/ironing aids, mail/suggestion receptacles, or non-storage transport trolleys). Furniture-hierarchy items (Wardrobes, Cabinets & Drawers under /furniture/, Shoe Rack under /furniture/shoe-racks-more/) were excluded from Storage per storage.md Sec.21/27 - the website explicitly places them inside its Furniture vertical, so Furniture is preferred per the rule's own tie-break, and Furniture is out of scope for this task. Bathroom Accessories (toothbrush holders, soap dishes, buckets, bathroom stools, bath tumblers, tube squeezers, hooks) were checked and excluded - none are storage/organization products, they are bathroom fixtures/accessories. Home Decor vertical (arb) was checked (wall decor, paintings, clocks, showpieces, vases, photo frames, home fragrance, diyas/candles, windchimes) and contains no textile or storage nodes. Two nodes needed content inspection to resolve ambiguity: Appliance Covers (fabric protective covers for washing machines/ACs/fridges - included as Textile, same logic as 'Furniture Cover -> Textile') and Rug Pads (sampled titles show these are actually jute/shag rugs and door mats mislabeled under a 'Rug Pads' slug, not underlay padding - included as Textile floor coverings). Mosquito Nets (polyester fabric bed nets) included as Textile at MEDIUM confidence - fabric bedroom accessory, not explicitly named in the rule list. Hooks and Door Hangers (wall/over-door hook organizers explicitly filed under Home Storage and Organization) included as Storage at MEDIUM confidence per site hierarchy. Diwan Sets, Quilt Battings, Roti Covers, Sofa Fabrics, and Curtain Fabrics included as Textile per explicit rule sections (bedding/upholstery-fabric/kitchen-cloth analogues). No duplicate URLs recorded; each leaf visited once and used for both classification passes.
